verdict.rationale: Simular documents running Sai on its own cloud virtual machine, a cloud Windows computer driven through the API, so tasks run off your own machine (simular-docs-23, simular-docs-1, simular-docs-13). It separately documents BYOD installs on your own Mac or Windows device (simular-docs-20), so a developer can try the agent on a cloud VM before running it on a real device. Missing for 10: explicit isolation or sandbox guarantees for the cloud VM, container-based execution, a documented workflow for moving from the cloud VM to a BYOD device, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
